title: A Regiment for the Lantern
author: Lior Ishikawa
blurb: Marguerite Winterbourne, a mapmaker's apprentice finishing the atlas the master died for, keeps a low profile and busy hands. Then the bridge — the only road out — closes for the season — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must keep a promise made in peacetime to someone now declared enemy before the armistice is signed — or isn't.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
